messages:
elaine: quick design sync — i'm iterating on a tiny 'invocation inspector' for the playground. goal: compactly surface structured output (schema), which function was called, and highlight where the runtime output deviates from the declared schema.

sam: i like that. main win is reducing clicks when debugging tool-calls. inline diffs next to each result line > separate big pane imo. :thumbsup:

mohit: accessibility nits: do not use color alone to mark mismatches. add an icon + text label (e.g., 'type mismatch'). also ensure diffs are keyboard focusable and exposed via aria-live so screen readers get updates when a result changes.

kevin: +1 to a11y. also proposal: keyboard shortcuts to cycle results/diffs. small draft keymap:
```
D -> toggle diffs for focused invocation
J / K -> next/prev invocation
Enter -> expand invocation details
```
Would let power users triage quickly.

elaine: thanks, kevin — i'll add the keymap to the prototype. question: should expanded schema show the entire function signature or just the fields referenced in the output? compactness vs context.

sam: prefer field-level view by default (compact). show full signature as collapsed subsection or via hover. keep it reachable with one keypress.

mohit: one more: when schema has enums/choices, show the expected set inline and highlight the chosen value. for contrast, outline mismatches with a dashed border + text "expected: <type>|<enum>".

kevin: UX tweak — show a tiny breadcrumb above the invocation: [model] > [function name] > [call-id]. helps when there're repeated ops in run history.

design-bot: uploaded image: invocation_inspector_v2.png (link) — mock shows inline diffs, icons for info/warning/error, and a focus ring state.

elaine: posted prototype link: https://figma.redwood/playground/invocation-inspector/v2 — please comment directly in figma. i’ll push a small a11y checklist for the implementation.

sam: copy nits for the diff labels: prefer 'Type mismatch' over 'Schema mismatch', more explicit for engineers.

mohit: add aria-labels like "invocation 3 of 8 — type mismatch on field `user.id`" so SR users can jump to the exact issue.

kevin: implementation question — do we compute diffs client-side or rely on the runtime to emit a delta? client-side is flexible but runs the risk of differing logic.

elaine: leaning runtime-emitted deltas (deterministic). will add a fallback client-side differ for older runtimes. runtime emitted payload should include: matched_fields[], mismatched_fields[], missing_fields[], extra_fields[].

sam: thanks — makes integration easier. one last UX ask: include a tiny 'accept as-shown' button for run-history snapshots so users can mark that a mismatch is intentional/known.

elaine: great idea — will add 'mark as accepted' and show a subtle badge in run history.

mohit: test plan note: include keyboard-only flows and a screen-reader walkthrough in the PR description.

kevin: i'll pair with eng on the keybinding implementation. if we can ship a11y-first, it's a win.

elaine: thanks all — i'll iterate and post updated mocks by EOD tomorrow. :wave:
